title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,751–1,800 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Taiwan is famous for its friendly small-business environment.
examples.zh: 台灣以其友善中小企業的經商環境著稱。

examples.en: She decided to start an online boutique business selling handmade ceramics.
examples.zh: 她決定開創一家線上選品店生意，專門販售手工陶瓷藝品。

examples.en: It is none of your personal business how he spends his weekend leisure time.
examples.zh: 他週末休閒時間究竟如何度過，純屬個人隱私，與你毫無關係。

examples.en: International trade drives economic prosperity across the island.
examples.zh: 國際貿易推動了全島的經濟繁榮。

examples.en: Taiwan maintains strong bilateral trade partnerships with countries worldwide.
examples.zh: 台灣與世界各國維持著緊密繁榮的雙邊經貿夥伴關係。

examples.en: The two schoolboys agreed to trade their rare baseball collector cards.
examples.zh: 兩位男同學達成共識，開心地交換了彼此手上的珍稀棒球收藏卡。

examples.en: Taiwan exports high-precision electronic components worldwide.
examples.zh: 台灣向全球出口高精密電子零組件。

examples.en: Tropical sweet mangoes and orchids are key agricultural exports.
examples.zh: 香甜多汁的熱帶芒果與嬌豔的蝴蝶蘭是重要的大宗外銷農產品。

examples.en: Strong global tech demand significantly boosted monthly export volume.
examples.zh: 全球強勁的科技硬體需求大幅推升了本月份的外銷出口總額。

examples.en: The country imports raw energy materials like crude oil and gas.
examples.zh: 該國進口原油與天然氣等能源原料。

examples.en: Imported Japanese matcha powder is used in their specialty pastry creations.
examples.zh: 他們的特色甜點創作特別嚴選自日本原裝進口的頂級抹茶粉。

examples.en: Rising customs tariffs may increase the retail price of imported cars.
examples.zh: 調高關稅稅率可能會進一步推升進口進口車輛的終端零售價格。

examples.en: Developing Asian markets create great business opportunities.
examples.zh: 新興亞洲市場創造了巨大的商業契機。

examples.en: Farmers sell freshly harvested organic vegetables at the morning farmers market.
examples.zh: 農夫們在清晨的農夫市集上擺攤販售當日現採的有機生鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: The tech startup hired a creative agency to market their fitness smartwatch.
examples.zh: 這家科技新創公司聘請了一家創意廣告代理商來行銷其健身智慧手錶。

examples.en: The technology industry is a core pillar of Taiwan's GDP.
examples.zh: 科技產業是台灣國內生產毛額（GDP）的核心支柱。

examples.en: Eco-tourism is an increasingly lucrative green industry for island nations.
examples.zh: 生態旅遊對海島國家而言是一項極具商機潛力的綠色朝陽產業。

examples.en: Government incentives encourage digital transformation across the service industry.
examples.zh: 政府各項獎勵措施積極輔導鼓勵服務業全面推動數位轉型升級。

examples.en: Taiwan produces the vast majority of advanced semiconductors.
examples.zh: 台灣生產了全球絕大多數的先進半導體晶片。

examples.en: Modern smartphones, electric cars, and AI servers rely on semiconductor chips.
examples.zh: 現代智慧型手機、電動車以及 AI 伺服器無一不仰賴先進半導體晶片。

examples.en: Hsinchu Science Park is globally revered as the heart of semiconductor innovation.
examples.zh: 新竹科學園區被國際公認為全球半導體創新研發與製造的心臟地帶。

examples.en: Tourism revitalizes the local economy of coastal towns.
examples.zh: 觀光旅遊業振興了濱海小鎮的在地經濟。

examples.en: A stable financial system and low unemployment support a strong economy.
examples.zh: 穩健健全的金融體系與低失業率是支撐整體經濟強勁發展的關鍵。

examples.en: Passengers traveling on long-distance budget flights booked economy class seats.
examples.zh: 搭乘長途平價廉價航班的旅客紛紛預訂了經濟實惠的經濟艙座位。

examples.en: Innovation drives sustained national economic growth.
examples.zh: 創新研發推動國家持續的經濟成長。

examples.en: The finance minister proposed several supportive economic stimulus measures.
examples.zh: 財政部長提出數項具體有力的經濟振興配套措施以活絡景氣。

examples.en: University students analyzed global trade imbalances in their economic theory class.
examples.zh: 大學經濟系學生在經濟理論課堂上深入探討全球貿易失衡現象。

examples.en: This innovative skincare product is popular among young adults.
examples.zh: 這款創新護膚產品深受年輕人喜愛。

examples.en: Software engineers tested every functional feature before launching the new product.
examples.zh: 軟體工程師在新產品正式推向市場前，對各項功能進行了全面測試。

examples.en: High customer satisfaction reflects the superior quality of their flagship product.
examples.zh: 極高的顧客滿意度充分印證了該品牌旗艦產品無可挑剔的卓越品質。

examples.en: Local farmers produce fresh organic mangoes and guavas.
examples.zh: 在地農民生產新鮮的有機芒果與芭樂。

examples.en: This high-efficiency automated assembly line can produce a thousand units daily.
examples.zh: 這條高效能的全自動化組裝流水線每日可生產製造一千台成品裝置。

examples.en: Supermarkets place crisp, colorful fresh produce right near the store entrance.
examples.zh: 超市通常將色澤鮮艷、清脆可口的生鮮蔬果擺設在最靠近大門入口處。

examples.en: Advanced precision manufacturing sets Taiwan apart globally.
examples.zh: 先進精密製造業讓台灣在國際舞台上脫穎而出。

examples.en: Smart robotics and artificial intelligence are transforming traditional manufacturing.
examples.zh: 智慧機器人與人工智慧正深刻重塑並顛覆傳統製造業的運作模式。

examples.en: Taiwan's bicycle manufacturing expertise supplies premier racing bikes globally.
examples.zh: 台灣精湛深厚的自行車製造實力為全球供應頂級專業公路競速賽車。

examples.en: Acer and Asus are globally recognized Taiwanese PC brands.
examples.zh: 宏碁（Acer）與華碩（Asus）是全球知名的台灣電腦品牌。

examples.en: Building a trustworthy brand reputation requires decades of consistent quality.
examples.zh: 建立值得信賴的卓越品牌商譽，往往需要數十年如一日的穩定品質。

examples.en: Many consumers remain deeply loyal to their favorite coffee brand.
examples.zh: 許多消費者對自己最鍾愛的咖啡品牌抱持著極高的忠誠度與黏著度。

examples.en: The company's circular green logo is easily recognizable.
examples.zh: 該公司的圓形綠色商標標誌極易辨識。

examples.en: Graphic designers redesigned the sleek corporate logo to attract Gen Z shoppers.
examples.zh: 平面設計師重新打造了簡約俐落的企業識別標誌，以吸引年輕 Z 世代消費者。

examples.en: The famous athletic logo with three bold stripes is recognized globally.
examples.zh: 擁有三條經典俐落斜槓線條的知名運動品牌標誌在全球享有極高辨識度。

examples.en: Good customer service builds lasting loyalty among shoppers.
examples.zh: 優質貼心的客戶服務能建立顧客長久的忠誠度。

examples.en: You can call the 24-hour customer service hotline for instant card cancellation.
examples.zh: 您可以撥打二十四小時免付費客服專線，即刻辦理信用卡緊急掛失手續。

examples.en: The responsive customer service team resolved my billing issue in five minutes.
examples.zh: 服務親切迅速的客服團隊在短短五分鐘內就妥善解決了我的帳單爭議。

examples.en: Smart consumers compare prices across platforms before purchasing.
examples.zh: 聰明的消費者在購物前會在各大平台比價。

examples.en: Consumer protection agencies protect shoppers against deceptive false advertising.
examples.zh: 消費者保護機構全力捍衛消費權益，防範誤導性的虛偽誇大不實廣告。

examples.en: Modern consumers increasingly prefer brands that practice environmental sustainability.
examples.zh: 現代消費者日益偏好選擇落實環境友善與企業永續發展的良心品牌。

examples.en: There is rising global demand for renewable green energy.
examples.zh: 全球對再生綠色能源的需求正持續攀升。

examples.en: Angry commuters demanded a thorough explanation from the rail company after delays.
examples.zh: 列車嚴重延誤之後，憤怒的通勤旅客要求鐵路營運公司給予合理解釋。

examples.en: High demand for concert tickets caused the online booking website to crash.
examples.zh: 演唱會門票引發的龐大搶購需求，導致線上售票系統瞬間癱瘓當機。

examples.en: Disrupted supply chains can lead to temporary product shortages.
examples.zh: 供應鏈中斷可能會導致商品暫時性缺貨。

examples.en: The city reservoir provides a reliable freshwater supply to urban households.
examples.zh: 市區水庫為整座都會區家庭提供了穩定乾淨且源源不絕的自來水供應。

examples.en: Relief teams rushed to supply clean drinking water and blankets to flood victims.
examples.zh: 救災隊伍十萬火急馳援災區，為水災災民緊急供應純淨飲用水與保暖毛毯。

examples.en: The new product line generated higher quarterly profits.
examples.zh: 全新產品線帶來了更高的季度營業利潤。

examples.en: Operating expenses were cut to improve the company's net profit margin.
examples.zh: 公司全面精簡營運管銷費用，以進一步拉高整體淨利潤率表現。

examples.en: Young entrepreneurs learned valuable lessons and profited greatly from the mentorship.
examples.zh: 年輕創業家從導師的傾囊相授中獲益匪淺，汲取了無比寶貴的實務經驗。

examples.en: The airline suffered heavy financial losses during border closures.
examples.zh: 邊境封閉期間該航空公司遭受了沉重的財務虧損。

examples.en: Wearing earplugs at rock concerts prevents irreversible long-term hearing loss.
examples.zh: 參加搖滾演唱會時配戴專業防護耳塞，能防範不可逆的長期聽力受損。

examples.en: We expressed our heartfelt condolences for the sad loss of her beloved grandmother.
examples.zh: 我們對她痛失摯愛慈祥的祖母表達了最深切的由衷哀悼與不捨之意。

examples.en: Many young people invest money in index funds regularly.
examples.zh: 許多青年定期將資金定額投資於指數型基金。

examples.en: It is always wise to invest time in acquiring fluent foreign language skills.
examples.zh: 將寶貴時間與心力投入在鍛鍊一口流利的外語能力上永遠是最明智的投資。

examples.en: Tech giants continue to invest billions of dollars in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
examples.zh: 各大科技巨頭持續投入數十億美元巨資，大舉興建人工智慧算力基礎建設。

examples.en: Education is the best long-term investment in your future.
examples.zh: 教育是對自己未來最棒的長期投資。

examples.en: Buying real estate in prime city locations has historically been a safe investment.
examples.zh: 從歷史經驗來看，在市中心精華黃金地段置產向來是相當穩健的保值投資。

examples.en: Venture capital funds made substantial early investments in clean biotech ventures.
examples.zh: 創業投資基金在早期階段對數家潛力綠色生技新創企業進行了關鍵大額投資。

examples.en: International tech investors showed great interest in local AI startups.
examples.zh: 國際科技投資人對本土的 AI 新創團隊表現出高度興趣。

examples.en: Prudent investors diversify their portfolios across bonds, equities, and gold.
examples.zh: 審慎穩健的投資人會將資產組合多元分散於債券、股票與黃金等多種標的。

examples.en: The CEO presented the quarterly roadmap clearly to reassure nervous institutional investors.
examples.zh: 執行長在法說會上條理分明地說明季度發展藍圖，以安撫緊張的機構法人投資人。

examples.en: The convenience store clerk checked the beverage stock in the back room.
examples.zh: 超商店員到後方庫房檢查飲品庫存。

examples.en: She owns several shares of dividend-paying tech stock in her portfolio.
examples.zh: 她的長期投資組合中持有數檔穩定配發豐厚現金股利的高科技績優股。

examples.en: Popular graphic novels are currently out of stock and will be reprinted soon.
examples.zh: 這部超人氣長篇圖文書目前全數缺貨中，出版商已緊急安排再版加印。

examples.en: The Taiwan Stock Market (Taiex) reached a new historic milestone.
examples.zh: 台灣股市加權指數（台股）創下了全新的歷史里程碑。

examples.en: Global stock markets experienced fluctuations following the interest rate hike.
examples.zh: 在各國央行宣布升息政策後，全球主要股票市場均出現了震盪波動。

examples.en: Beginners should learn financial valuation basics before entering the stock market.
examples.zh: 投資新手在正式投身股票市場之前，應當先扎實研讀財務估值基本面知識。

examples.en: Companies advertise their newest gadgets on YouTube and Instagram.
examples.zh: 各家公司在 YouTube 與 Instagram 上為最新科技新品打廣告。

examples.en: The bakery will advertise its grand opening discount in the local paper.
examples.zh: 這家烘焙坊將在地方報刊與社群上限時刊登盛大開幕特惠折扣廣告。

examples.en: Organic food brands frequently advertise their farm-to-table natural ingredients.
examples.zh: 有機天然食品品牌經常大力宣傳其產地直送、無添加的新鮮食材特色。

examples.en: An eye-catching digital advertisement displayed on the building screen.
examples.zh: 大樓外牆巨型螢幕上播放著引人注目的數位廣告。

examples.en: Skipping YouTube video advertisements is a premium membership feature.
examples.zh: 免等待直接略過 YouTube 影片片頭插入廣告是付費會員的專屬功能。

examples.en: Classified advertisements in the back of the newspaper list apartments for rent.
examples.zh: 報紙後頁刊登的分類小廣告羅列了各區套房與公寓出租的最新資訊。

examples.en: Creative marketing campaigns help brands gain viral popularity.
examples.zh: 富有創意的行銷活動能幫助品牌獲得病毒式的知名度。

examples.en: Digital marketing strategies rely heavily on search engine optimization (SEO).
examples.zh: 數位行銷推廣策略極度仰賴精準的搜尋引擎最佳化（SEO）技術布局。

examples.en: He accepted an internship in the global marketing department of an athletic brand.
examples.zh: 他順利獲選進入一家知名國際運動品牌的全球市場行銷部擔任實習生。

examples.en: Several sports drink companies sponsor the national marathon.
examples.zh: 數家運動飲料品牌贊助了這場全國馬拉松大賽。

examples.en: The tech giant signed on as the primary title sponsor for the world championship.
examples.zh: 該科技巨擘正式簽約擔任本屆世界電競錦標賽的首要官方冠名贊助商。

examples.en: Local businesses sponsor uniforms for the elementary school baseball team.
examples.zh: 社區在地熱心商家紛紛出資贊助國小少棒隊全新統一比賽戰袍球衣。

examples.en: Professional badminton players receive brand equipment sponsorships.
examples.zh: 職業羽球選手獲得各大品牌的球具裝備贊助。

examples.en: Securing corporate sponsorship is essential to fund our community arts festival.
examples.zh: 爭取到企業界慷慨解囊的資金贊助，是籌辦我們社區藝術節的成敗關鍵。

examples.en: The athlete’s jersey displayed logos from all major commercial sponsorships.
examples.zh: 該名頂尖運動員的比賽隊服上印滿了各大主要商業贊助商的品牌商標。

examples.en: The university formed an academic partnership with TSMC.
examples.zh: 該大學與台積電建立了產學合作夥伴關係。

examples.en: A long-term business partnership must be built on mutual trust and shared values.
examples.zh: 長久穩固的商業合作夥伴關係，必須建立在彼此互信與共同價值觀之上。

examples.en: The airlines announced a code-share partnership to expand their international flight routes.
examples.zh: 兩家航空公司聯合宣布推展代碼共享夥伴合作，以全面拓寬國際航線版圖。

examples.en: The two tech giants signed a multi-million-dollar trade deal.
examples.zh: 兩大科技巨頭簽署了一份數百萬美元的貿易協議。

examples.en: You got a fantastic deal buying that refurbished laptop at half price.
examples.zh: 你以半價優惠買下那台原廠整新優質筆電，真是撿到了一個大便宜。

examples.en: Experienced team leaders know how to deal with unexpected customer complaints calmly.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的團隊主管懂得如何從容冷靜地應對處理突如其來的顧客客訴。

examples.en: The union negotiated with management for higher holiday wages.
examples.zh: 工會與資方就提高節假日加班薪資展開協商。

examples.en: Shoppers at traditional flea markets often negotiate prices with friendly booth vendors.
examples.zh: 逛傳統跳蚤市場的顧客經常會親切地與攤位老闆討價還價商量價格。

examples.en: The foreign diplomat was dispatched to negotiate a peaceful regional trade treaty.
examples.zh: 該名資深外交使節臨危受命被派往國外，負責談判簽署和平區域經貿條約。

examples.en: After peaceful negotiations, both parties finalized the agreement.
examples.zh: 經過和平協商後，雙方最終敲定了合作協議。

examples.en: Complex salary negotiations between players and management took nearly three weeks.
examples.zh: 球員與球團管理階層之間錯綜複雜的薪資待遇談判協商耗時將近三個星期。

examples.en: Good listening skills are an invaluable asset during any high-stakes business negotiation.
examples.zh: 在任何攸關重大商業利益的高層談判桌上，善於傾聽是一項無比珍貴的資產。

examples.en: Read the contract terms carefully before clicking 'I Agree'.
examples.zh: 點擊「我同意」之前，請務必仔細閱讀合約條款。

examples.en: The two sides agreed to mutually acceptable payment and delivery terms.
examples.zh: 商業雙方就彼此均能完全接受的付款條件與交貨期限條款達成共識。

examples.en: He explained quantum physics in simple, accessible terms that children could grasp.
examples.zh: 他用深入淺出、孩童也能輕鬆聽懂的平實用詞講解深奧的量子物理。

examples.en: The overseas container shipment arrived safely at Keelung Harbor.
examples.zh: 海外貨櫃輪出貨已平安抵達基隆港。

examples.en: You will receive an SMS tracking notification as soon as your shipment leaves the depot.
examples.zh: 您的商品貨物一旦自物流集散中心出貨出庫，您將立刻收到簡訊追蹤通知。

examples.en: Heavy storm swells delayed the cargo vessel carrying the vital medical shipment.
examples.zh: 兇猛的海上暴風狂瀾延誤了載運重要醫療緊急物資船班的出貨抵達時間。

examples.en: Buying snacks at wholesale stores like Costco saves family budgets.
examples.zh: 在好市多等批發賣場大量採買零食能節省家庭開銷。

examples.en: The boutique owner buys jewelry at wholesale prices directly from artisans.
examples.zh: 精品店老闆直接向工藝手作匠人以批發價大宗採購純手工精美飾品。

examples.en: Selling merchandise wholesale yields lower unit profit but generates immense total volume.
examples.zh: 採取整批大宗批發銷售模式單件毛利雖低，但能帶來龐大可觀的總出貨量。

examples.en: The recommended retail price is clearly printed on the box.
examples.zh: 建議零售價已清楚印在包裝外盒上。

examples.en: The retail sector experienced a boom during the annual anniversary department sale.
examples.zh: 百貨公司週年慶特賣期間，整體實體零售業績迎來了爆發性強勁成長。

examples.en: E-commerce platforms transformed conventional retail shopping habits forever.
examples.zh: 蓬勃發展的電子商務網購平台永遠改寫了消費大眾傳統的門市零售購物習慣。

examples.en: E-commerce platforms and convenience stores are major retailers.
examples.zh: 電商平台與超商是台灣主要的重要零售通路商。

examples.en: Major fashion retailers launched seasonal clearance discounts ahead of autumn.
examples.zh: 各大知名連鎖流行服飾零售業者在秋季來臨前紛紛祭出換季出清特惠。

examples.en: Independent book retailers host intimate author readings to build local community.
examples.zh: 獨立特色書店零售商定期舉辦溫馨的作者新書朗讀會，緊密連結在地社區。

examples.en: The fruit wholesaler supplies fresh seasonal produce to restaurants.
examples.zh: 水果批發商為各大餐廳供應新鮮時令蔬果。

examples.en: Small flower shops place pre-dawn orders with the central flower market wholesaler.
examples.zh: 街角小花店清晨天未破曉便前往批發市場大盤商處搶先下單訂購鮮花。

examples.en: Wholesalers negotiate bulk discounts directly from large manufacturing factories.
examples.zh: 批發大盤商直接向大型生產製造工廠洽商取得最具競爭力的大宗進貨折扣。

examples.en: The exclusive distributor imports official anime merchandise from Tokyo.
examples.zh: 獨家總經銷商從東京原裝進口官方正版動漫周邊。

examples.en: The beverage company relies on regional distributors to supply mountain convenience stores.
examples.zh: 這家知名飲料大廠仰賴各地區分銷經銷商，將飲品準時配送至偏遠山區超商。

examples.en: Film distributors decide which international theater screens will show the blockbuster.
examples.zh: 電影全球發行商全權負責規劃評估該年度大片將在哪些國際院線大銀幕上映。

examples.en: Giant Manufacturing is one of the world's premier bicycle makers.
examples.zh: 巨大機械（捷安特）是全球頂尖的自行車製造大廠。

examples.en: Contact the original equipment manufacturer if your washing machine requires genuine parts.
examples.zh: 若您的滾筒洗衣機需要更換原廠正品零件，請直接聯繫設備原裝製造商。

examples.en: Taiwanese computer hardware manufacturers supply components to global tech firms.
examples.zh: 台灣電腦硬體專業製造廠商長期為全球頂尖科技公司供應關鍵高階零件。

examples.en: Modern robotic factories operate with automated assembly lines.
examples.zh: 現代化機器人工廠採用全自動化組裝流水線運作。

examples.en: The shoe factory implements strict safety protocols to protect workers from accidents.
examples.zh: 這座製鞋工廠落實執行嚴格的安全衛生準則，全力保護產線作業員工安全。

examples.en: Solar panels installed across the factory roof supply green power for machinery.
examples.zh: 工廠平頂屋頂上鋪設的太陽能集熱板，為廠內重型機械運作供應綠色電力。

examples.en: Automated delivery robots move packages efficiently inside the logistics warehouse.
examples.zh: 自動導引機器人在物流倉庫內高效搬運包裹。

examples.en: Thousands of shipping pallets are stored neatly on towering steel racks in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 倉庫內部高聳的鋼製重型貨架上整齊堆疊著成千上萬件運載貨物的棧板。

examples.en: The company leased a climate-controlled warehouse to store delicate vintage wine.
examples.zh: 該公司特別承租了一座恆溫恆濕的專業物流倉庫，用以存放嬌貴的陳年名酒。

examples.en: Supermarkets perform regular inventory counts to replenish empty shelves.
examples.zh: 超級市場定期盤點庫存以適時為空貨架補貨。

examples.en: Barcode scanners help workers track warehouse inventory with pinpoint precision.
examples.zh: 條碼雷射掃描槍協助倉儲盤點人員以無比精確的精準度實時追蹤倉庫存貨。

examples.en: Excessive surplus inventory forces department stores to hold deep clearance sales.
examples.zh: 龐大過剩的積壓庫存促使各大百貨商場不得不祭出破盤下殺的清倉特賣。

examples.en: This laptop comes with a two-year international manufacturer warranty.
examples.zh: 這台筆電附有原廠提供的兩年全球國際保固。

examples.en: Dropping your waterproof phone into saltwater voids the official repair warranty.
examples.zh: 將防水手機意外掉落進高鹽分海水中將導致官方免費維修保固失效。

examples.en: Keep your stamped purchase receipt safe inside the product warranty booklet.
examples.zh: 請妥善將蓋有店章的統一發票與購買證明隨手保存在產品保固說明書中。

examples.en: Strict quality control ensures zero defects before products ship out.
examples.zh: 嚴格的品管把關確保產品出貨前達到零缺陷標準。

examples.en: Inspectors in the quality control department test food samples for bacterial safety.
examples.zh: 品質管制稽核部門檢驗員每日隨機抽檢食品樣本，嚴格把關生菌數安全。

examples.en: Every bicycle frame undergoes stress testing to meet international quality control standards.
examples.zh: 每一具出廠自行車車架均歷經嚴酷的疲勞應力測試，符合國際品管標準。

examples.en: We appreciate receiving constructive customer feedback on our app.
examples.zh: 我們非常感謝收到使用者對我們 App 的寶貴建設性回饋。

examples.en: Honest user feedback helped the developers fix bugs and simplify the user interface.
examples.zh: 來自忠實用戶的真實誠懇回饋，協助研發團隊快速排除錯誤並簡化介面。

examples.en: The teacher provided encouraging written feedback on each student's narrative essay.
examples.zh: 國文老師在每位學生的記敘文習作卷末寫下了溫暖鼓勵的詳細批改回饋。

examples.en: Check customer reviews and photos before booking the seaside hotel.
examples.zh: 預訂海景飯店前先查看住客的真實評論與照片。

examples.en: Students should review their vocabulary flashcards every evening before bedtime.
examples.zh: 學生們每天晚上就寢前都應該將單字記憶卡拿出來認真複習一遍。

examples.en: The medical committee met to conduct a thorough review of clinical trial results.
examples.zh: 醫學倫理審查委員會召開會議，對新藥臨床試驗的完整數據進行嚴格審查。

examples.en: The braised pork rice eatery holds a 4.8-star Google rating.
examples.zh: 這家滷肉飯小吃名店在 Google 地圖上擁有 4.8 顆星高分好評。

examples.en: Drivers with high customer service ratings receive bonus incentives on ride-hailing apps.
examples.zh: 在叫車平台 App 上維持超高顧客服務評分的優質司機能獲得額外獎勵金。

examples.en: The live sports championship finale shattered all television viewership ratings.
examples.zh: 萬眾矚目的體育總決賽實況轉播收視率一舉打破了歷年電視台收視最高紀錄。
